what.en: The street address of the San Francisco storefront the affidavit is filed for itself, with suite or unit. Not a mailing, head-office or overseas address, and not a P.O. box. The block/lot number has its own box.
what.zh: 填写声明书所针对的旧金山门店本身的街道地址（含门牌号/单元号）。不能填写邮寄地址、总部地址、海外地址或邮政信箱。地块编号（Block/Lot）另有专栏。

ifNone.en: This line names the US location being permitted, so there is no substitute: secure the lease or site first, then file with that address.
ifNone.zh: 此栏填写的是申请许可的美国经营地点本身，没有替代方案：请先签订租约或确定场地，再用该地址申请。

confirmations.quote: additional controls and regulations will apply depending on the zoning district where the proposed business will be located.
This affidavit for Formula Retail must accompany any Permit Application for any Alterations, New Construction, Commercial Tenant Improvements, Change of Use or Signage

notes: Block/Lot is a parcel number, not an address line, and is not ruled here.
